profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at ProLiant
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with over a decade of experience building scalable, maintainable systems using C#, .NET, SQL Server, and modern web technologies. Proven track record leading projects, modernizing legacy platforms, and delivering high-performance solutions in both startup and enterprise settings. Strong background in building responsive, form-driven UIs with reactive programming principles. Especially enjoys digging into complex technical challenges and finding practical, long-lasting solutions. Focused on clean, reliable code, team collaboration, and continuous improvement.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built a flexible query-builder UI that lets users assemble custom data queries without needing SQL skills
Maintained and updated a shared UI component library used across multiple teams
Migrated critical services to .NET 6 and Angular 15, which improved performance and maintainability
Broke apart some of our older, monolithic systems into smaller services and set up clean communication patterns between them
Created and optimized stored procedure that vastly improved application performance
Informally mentored newer devs and reviewed code regularly to help maintain quality
positions.insights: Transact-SQL (T-SQL), Microsoft SQL Server and +12 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on multi-client web platforms using Angular and ASP.NET
Developed SSRS reports, created and optimized stored procedures, decreasing runtime by up to 95%
Collaborated with internal consultants to build out custom client integrations using IBM's platform
Participated in code reviews, planning, retros, and served as scrum master
positions.insights: Transact-SQL (T-SQL), Microsoft SQL Server and +11 skills

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Led a large internal project for a manufacturing client — team peaked at around 15 people
Designed and developed several web and Windows-based tools used in production settings
Built a custom load testing suite that simulated over 10,000 users to identify system bottlenecks
Delivered two major app overhauls ahead of schedule, each with zero major bugs at launch
positions.insights: Transact-SQL (T-SQL), Microsoft SQL Server and +4 skills

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Built out automated browser testing using Selenium in Java for a number of retail-facing web apps
Integrated tests into Jenkins for automated runs and reports
Worked alongside QA teams to identify test gaps and improve the overall test coverage and stability
